podcast.title: Early Examples and Roots
podcast.body: While it surged in the 1980s, earlier examples of power ballads, such as "Beth" by Kiss, demonstrate that the genre had established roots prior to its mainstream explosion. "Beth by Kiss, awesome."

podcast.title: Inevitable Rise in the 1980s
podcast.body: The power ballad genre was projected to become "inescapable" in the 1980s, with artists like April Wine offering an early indication of its coming prevalence. "But the power ballad will be inescapable in the 80s."
